notes.en:
Herdline 0.6.90 (Experimental, 10142)

- Chat metadata now sits lower, immediately above the editor and below notices, queue controls and attachments.
- The footer uses two compact 11sp monospace rows: model/provider gets the full first row, with the pane directory and per-reply cost on the second. The separate filled panel and divider are gone. Tap the full footer for unabridged Details; its 48dp interaction target is preserved.
- Dense landscape/keyboard Chat retains its in-list footer, and read-only Chat keeps its fallback. Metadata still belongs to the latest recorded assistant message; absent model or price is never invented, and no session-total cost is claimed.

Verification: focused footer and composer-fit checks, four light/dark normal/narrow visual captures, Details, and real stock OMP resumed-history Chat in portrait with the keyboard hidden and shown passed on an isolated Android 17 emulator. The real layout had one footer below notices, above the editor, and above the IME with no overlap. Dense/read-only layout was not re-exercised in this delta. No LLM calls or sends during runtime verification. Final signed runtime and Samsung rendering were not separately tested.
